entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: From the records, it appears that the aforementioned case was instituted on the complaint of Food Security Officer in which it was alleged that adulterated and inedible mustard oil which was manufactured in a factory was being circulated on the aforesaid vehicle which has been released in favour of the opposite party.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner was Patna High Court CR. REV. No.1090 of 2017(4)
dt.15-03-2018 not in a position to show any provision under the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 for confiscation of any vehicle used for the purposes of transporting adulterated food items.
Per force, the seizure of vehicle in such cases would be required dealt with under the provision of Sections 452 and 457 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

A perusal of the order impugned reflects that the court below took into account that there was no other claimant of the vehicle and that all the necessary/relevant papers indicated that opposite party State Of Bihar Through Superintendent ... vs Satish Kumar on 15 March, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132224327/
1 was the owner of the same.
